units.rawText: My first encounter with the Professor... I believe it was beneath the sea in Copley. De Lacey and I were searching for Sueyoi, who had gone missing.

units.rawText: Thank you again for helping us rescue Sueyoi. If it weren't for your commandeering, the situation would've been way more dangerous.
